Aquiring firewood: Off-island wood is completely restricted, and they use an ad in their resort guide reminding campers of the harmful impacts of bringing in outside wood. They do sell firewood but it is all island grown. They also process some wood themselves.

Name: Upper Clements Cottages & RV Park
Aquiring firewood: Outside wood is restricted. Clients are informed of the threat of bringing in outside wood they want to bring it in. Locally sourced wood is avaliable for purchase. The majority of the wood is bought on site or locally sourced.

Name: Whidden Park Campground & Cottages
Aquiring firewood: Wood not restricted. They sell locally sourced softwood and sell about 10 cords per year.

Name: Whispering Pines RV Estate
Aquiring firewood: Outside wood is not restricted. They do not provide wood. They say that most campers bring in scrap wood from house building.

Name: Williams Brook- Mount Carleton Provincial Park
Yogi Bear's Jellystone Park Camping Resort
Aquiring firewood: Outside wood is not restricted and locally sourced wood is available for a fee.
